verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a local, open-source Unix-like terminal app for iOS. It has no hosted service, account system, or product API whose credentials could be issued or scoped, so issuing least-privilege API credentials to an agent is a category error for this kind of product. Its Apple Shortcuts integration and pickFolder directory access are local automation and file-access features, not credential issuance, so they do not make this axis apply.
